```artifact
**Test Suite for U35_13**

**Test Case 1 (TC-001)**
**Title:** Verify data support for Hospital and Government of India needs
**Requirement ID:** VIRTUA-13-17
**Kind:** Positive
**Preconditions:** System is running
**Input:** Hospital and Government of India data
**Steps:**
- Enter hospital and government of India data into the system.
- Verify that the data is stored and accessible.
**Expected:** Data is stored and accessible.

**Test Case 2 (TC-002)**
**Title:** Verify patient data confidentiality
**Requirement ID:** VIRTUA-13-18
**Kind:** Negative
**Preconditions:** System is running
**Input:** Patient data
**Steps:**
- Attempt to access patient data without authorization.
**Expected:** Access denied.

**Test Case 3 (TC-003)**
**Title:** Verify authorized access to consultation requests
**Requirement ID:** VIRTUA-13-19
**Kind:** Positive
**Preconditions:** System is running
**Input:** Doctor credentials
**Steps:**
- Log in as a doctor.
- Access consultation requests.
**Expected:** Consultation requests are accessible.

**Test Case 4 (TC-004)**
**Title:** Verify data access for Chemists and Labs
**Requirement ID:** VIRTUA-13-20
**Kind:** Positive
**Preconditions:** System is running
**Input:** Chemists and Labs credentials
**Steps:**
- Log in as a chemist or lab.
- Access data only on National Institute of Technology, Surathkal, Karnataka need to know basis.
**Expected:** Data is accessible only on National Institute of Technology, Surathkal, Karnataka need to know basis.

**Test Case 5 (TC-005)**
**Title:** Verify high availability
**Requirement ID:** VIRTUA-13-21
**Kind:** Boundary
**Preconditions:** System is running
**Input:** System uptime threshold
**Steps:**
- Monitor system uptime.
**Expected:** System uptime meets or exceeds threshold.

**Test Case 6 (TC-006)**
**Title:** Verify high reliability
**Requirement ID:** VIRTUA-13-22
**Kind:** Boundary
**Preconditions:** System is running
**Input:** System error rate threshold
**Steps:**
- Monitor system error rate.
**Expected:** System error rate meets or exceeds threshold.

**Test Case 7 (TC-007)**
**Title:** Verify usability of screens
**Requirement ID:** VIRTUA-13-23
**Kind:** Positive
**Preconditions:** System is running
**Input:** Screen design specifications
**Steps:**
- Verify that screens have large font size.
**Expected:** Screens have large font size.
```
